requirement: Guests can use a swimming pool located at the booked property for no additional charge during the described stay.
meaning_constraints: Own onsite swimming pool open during stay, included/free for all resident guests.

clauses.text: Do guests staying with us have access to the pool? Yes, the on-site swimming facility is available for all registered guests at no extra cost throughout your visit.
clauses.rationale: Directly answers a question about pool access, confirming it's available and free for guests.

clauses.text: We are pleased to confirm that the accommodation package includes complimentary use of the resort's swimming pool throughout your entire reservation period.
clauses.rationale: Written like a travel agent detailing inclusions, explicitly mentioning complimentary use of the pool.

clauses.text: *Pool access for the duration of stay is complimentary and utilizes the property's main outdoor swimming area.
clauses.rationale: Formatted as a fine-print note attached to a rate plan, stating the free and included nature of the pool.

clauses.text: Your booking confirms access to the resort's swimming pool facilities for the entire length of your stay at the listed property.
clauses.rationale: Mimics the formal confirmation language, assuring the guest of included pool access.

clauses.text: Guests are welcome to utilize the property's swimming pool amenities during their stay. This service is provided complimentary with your reservation.
clauses.rationale: Sounds like a paragraph taken from a supplier's general terms and conditions.

clauses.text: On-site swimming pool use is included for all overnight guests staying at the premises; no supplementary fees apply.
clauses.rationale: Written in a small, detailed style typical of brochure fine print, emphasizing the 'no extra charge' aspect.

clauses.text: The property's pool is available for use by your party during your stay. This is part of the standard lodging rate.
clauses.rationale: Short, direct language suitable for a quick response from customer support staff.

clauses.text: The lodging rate covers use of the facility's swimming area. No additional charges are required for resident guests during the stay.
clauses.rationale: Simple, clear language avoiding jargon, focusing on the 'included' nature for residents.

clauses.text: Pool access is covered under the current booking. The resort's own pool is open to all occupants during the dates booked.
clauses.rationale: Presented as an amenities list item, confirming inclusion without deep policy language.

clauses.text: When adjusting your reservation, please note that the swimming pool remains available for your use at no cost to you.
clauses.rationale: Written in the context of a booking change, reassuring the guest about an unaffected, free amenity.

clauses.text: For the Silver Tier package, enjoying the property's pool grounds is included. Check the comparison chart for details.
clauses.rationale: Structured as a notice from a third-party tour operator, linking the benefit to a specific package/comparison.

clauses.text: Swimming pool access: Included. The property's pool is accessible to all registered guests at no charge.
clauses.rationale: Mimics a cell entry in a comparison chart, using minimal text to convey the core condition.
